sample_unit: nuclear medicine technology board examination-style questions

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLMs on nuclear medicine board-style questions with versus without retrieval-augmented generation
links.effect: With RAG, top OpenAI models reached 0.787 and 0.783 overall accuracy; Anthropic Opus 0.773 and Gemini 1.5 Pro 0.750 with RAG; RAG increased accuracy of an off-the-shelf model.
links.quote: This study also demonstrates that adding a RAG workflow can increase the accuracy of an off-the-shelf model.

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLMs on nuclear medicine board examination questions and directly tests the deployment safeguard/practice of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to off-the-shelf models vs. without RAG.
